topic: managing weekly meal planning and grocery logistics

gold_fact.text: The user batch-cooks meals for the week every Sunday; this recurs as a weekly habit across multiple sessions.

question: What does the user typically do on Sundays?

traps.description: One session mentions a special one-time Sunday brunch with friends, not the recurring batch-cooking.
User once says they were too busy to cook one particular Sunday, which could mislead a system into denying the habit.

shared_context.one_off_distractor: a one-time Sunday brunch with friends

rationale: Answer requires recognizing a recurring weekly behaviour despite a one-off exception; a w/e/o store cannot aggregate repetitions into a habit.
